desc: Compute the 32-bit FNV-1a hash over the 8 bytes of a 64-bit value n, processing bytes in LITTLE-ENDIAN order (least-significant byte first). n is any int64 (|n|<2^63) and is treated as its unsigned 64-bit two's-complement pattern, so negatives hash via their raw bytes (n=-1 -> eight 0xFF bytes). Algorithm: h = 2166136261 (offset basis); for i in 0..7: byte = (u >> (8*i)) & 0xFF; h = h xor byte; h = (h * 16777619) mod 2^32. Return h in [0, 2^32-1]. Extract each byte with a logical right shift by 8*i (so high bytes of negatives come through correctly), and keep h reduced mod 2^32 after every multiply with a 0xFFFFFFFF mask. fnv1a32(0)=2615243109.
